name: pipe_chain_link
description: Next link of a pipe chain (proposals_v1 rank 2). A real multi-line magrittr/native pipe chain from the normalized CRAN corpus is cut right after the `|>`/`%>%` operator that ends a line; the completion is the next chain link line verbatim (the rest of the chain stays in the suffix). Ground truth = the corpus line - exact by construction; the model draw must equal it (tier-1 exact gate in pipe_cut_cursor).
novelty_note: finish_block completes function bodies from the block START and ast_fim samples argument_list spans mid-call; neither teaches line-granular next-link continuation of a pipe chain - the most repeated edit shape in tidyverse reporting code. Absorbs gtsummary table-chaining as a stratum. Tree-sitter construction (operator must END its line, RHS call begins the next line, chain head always inside the prefix window so the data context is visible); validator tier: exact text on the emitted link with a structural tree-sitter floor (one clean call after stripping the trailing operator).
